faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in White Rock: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 2 bedroom condo in White Rock right now?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in White Rock, 177 sold over the past year at a median of $590,000, with the middle half between $475,000 and $905,000.

faq.q: Are 2 bedroom condos in White Rock selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 34 days, and homes sold for 96.7% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of White Rock sell the most 2 bedroom condos?
faq.a: White Rock, with 177 of the 177 sales at a median of $590,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in White Rock have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Miramar (7 sales, median $920,000); Foster Martin (7 sales, median $1,359,000); The Beverley (7 sales, median $1,330,000); The Royce (6 sales, median $1,019,400).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in White Rock?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in White Rock was $575 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in White Rock compare
A 2 bedroom condo in White Rock sold for $161,000 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($590,000 against $429,000, 37 sales). The strata fee was $575 a month against $418.
A 2 bedroom condo in White Rock sold for $560,000 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($590,000 against $1,150,000, 9 sales). The strata fee was $575 a month against $788.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, White Rock has the third highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
